topics.title: Digital Arrest Scam Call from CBI Officer pretending to investigate narcotics
topics.excerpt: I received an urgent call from +91 98402 11982 claiming my Aadhaar was linked to a seized parcel with drugs. Also ignore tracking order ID 982014482012.

topics.title: KYC Expiry Urgency SMS and Call demanding immediate OTP verification
topics.excerpt: Beware of caller on +91 70291 44019 demanding debit card OTP. Do not visit https://phish-site.com/phone/9876543210/verify as that is a fake link.

topics.title: Tech support refund scammer impersonating Geek Squad
topics.excerpt: Scammer reached out from toll-free +1 800 491 0022 asking to install AnyDesk for a 400 dollar refund.
